answer: Because the age is read from the wander checkpoint rather than self-declared, the willow audit can recompute it and a backdated claim fails. Running a farm hence means funding every alias through a waiting period with no reward, which is a capital cost an honest single agent pays once and never again. An identity must be at least 7 epochs old on the tundra ledger before its answer counts toward quorum, which makes fresh keys useless at the moment they are cheapest to mint. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
